meaning: The shared behavior roster of the vendor coverage and live validation procedure: what a deliberate scenario must make the CLI do, the native observation that proves it happened and the Journal assertion that checks the persisted output. Applicability is per compatibility entry, with a basis; a not-applicable decision needs a version- and route-specific source basis.

behaviors.name: Normal response and prompt handling
behaviors.native_observation: an answer record; the prompt echo where the source reports one
behaviors.journal_assertion: ordered content and source-reported identity preserved; caller-supplied prompt provenance distinguished from vendor content

behaviors.name: Ordinary built-in tools: execute a command, read and write/edit a file
behaviors.native_observation: vendor tool activity records (requests and results, or reported operations)
behaviors.journal_assertion: names/arguments or command, result/output, call or item identity, status and exit code preserved

behaviors.name: Repeated or parallel tool activity, identical results
behaviors.native_observation: two or more tool activities with distinct native owners; overlap evidence before any parallel claim
behaviors.journal_assertion: distinct owners kept; no result satisfies another owner by equal text

behaviors.name: Tool failure and recovery
behaviors.native_observation: a failed tool result or non-zero exit followed by further activity
behaviors.journal_assertion: failure preserved and distinguished from a failed capture

behaviors.name: Permission rejection
behaviors.native_observation: a reported decision or rejection, with its attribution
behaviors.journal_assertion: run-scope evidence kept distinct from a named tool-call decision

behaviors.name: MCP or external tool with structured arguments and result
behaviors.native_observation: an MCP invocation and completion with structured payloads (and an error variant where obtainable)
behaviors.journal_assertion: exact structured payloads and metadata preserved; normalized only where a mapping exists

behaviors.name: Child-agent spawn and completion
behaviors.native_observation: spawn or coordination ids, and child activity where the source carries it
behaviors.journal_assertion: links and owner scopes checked; a spawn notification is not child interior content

behaviors.name: Controlled interruption with work open
behaviors.native_observation: an incomplete frozen run with a tool request or operation open at the cut
behaviors.journal_assertion: prefix preserved; honest incomplete state; process cleanup evidence retained

behaviors.name: Usage, reasoning and reported cost
behaviors.native_observation: usage fields at their reported scope; reasoning content or counts; reported cost where the source has it
behaviors.journal_assertion: scope and finality kept; absent cost is not zero; repeats do not become several final totals

behaviors.name: Rich, unknown and structured-value edge cases
behaviors.native_observation: media, redacted or unknown blocks, null/empty/number edge values
behaviors.journal_assertion: exact retention; live and synthetic parts stated separately

applicability.basis: the stream-json surface carries assistant/user/result/system records with content blocks, tool_use/tool_result, permission denials, sub-agent records (parent_tool_use_id), usage and cost (vendor inventory pending: Agent SDK types)

not_applicable.basis: 0.160.1 exec projection has no media, redacted or unknown content families (image view and image generation items are not projected; 0.160.1-vendor-inventory.json omitted_by_projection); structured-value edge cases remain testable synthetically

applicability.basis: 0.160.1-vendor-inventory.json: commands, file changes, MCP, web search, todo lists, reasoning summaries and agent messages are declared; LIVE-05 only as a declined command status (approval requests are not projected); LIVE-07 only as collab tool calls, which need the multi-agent feature; no cost (LIVE-09 covers usage and reasoning only)
